stem: Which answer choice best describes the movement of the object between the times of 0 and 6 seconds on the graph?
visual_elements: graph showing Distance Versus Time with Distance (m) on the y-axis from 0 to 10 and Time (s) on the x-axis from 0 to 10. The plotted line ascends linearly from (0,0) to (5,10) and then remains flat at 10 from 5 to 10 seconds.
